Climbed aboard. <break time="0.8s" /> Saying that he had lost his chief mate. <break time="0.8s" /> Pretending to be a little hard of hearing. <break time="0.8s" /> I made him repeat everything. <break time="0.8s" /> In a loud voice. <break time="0.8s" /> For I wanted the hidden listener. <break time="0.8s" /> In my cabin. <break time="0.8s" /> To hear every word. <break time="0.8s" /> That
